activity_context.topic_title: Type I and II Regions in Two-Dimensional Space

feedback.problem: Which of the following is a type I region in two-dimensional space?
feedback.worked_solution:
A type I region can be written as

$$
D={(x,y)\,:\,a\le x\le b,\,g(x)\le y\le f(x)},
$$

where $f$ and $g$ are continuous functions.

A type I region has the property that a vertical line drawn through the region intersects the region in a single interval only.

Among the given options, the only type I region is the following.
